parameters.content:
## 1. Intake
Every channel is normalized into one envelope. Enable the email, Shopify and Drive triggers after adding their credentials.

## 2. AI extraction
Unstructured text goes to the LLM, which must answer with the strict LogisticsOrder JSON schema and a confidence score.

## 3. Validate & enrich
Clean fields, build the idempotency key, verify both addresses with Google Maps.

## 4. Dedupe & quote
Skip orders already in the TMS, then get a price and vehicle from the TMS.

## 5. Book or review
Clean orders are booked, dispatched and confirmed. Anything uncertain becomes a draft and goes to Slack for approval.
